title: GG 9 · Dashboard: Global Genius problems and downtime
walkthroughSteps: A red triangle after the Claim ID in the Claims portfolio marks a claim with a Global Genius problem. Click it to see what broke and what to do.
Status reads Failed only when the claim itself couldn't be set up in Global Genius. A failed payment, reserve, recovery or section keeps Open.
Claims with a problem sort first, so none hide past row 5.
While Global Genius is down there are no triangles for items waiting on it; one banner says there is nothing to do.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dashboard · Claim not set up in Global Genius: Failed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; colleague Figma design (claims portfolio triangle + popover, Claim Overview banner); UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann, Claims portfolio (My claims, last 30 days).

**You see:** CLM-2024-028 is the first row. A red triangle right after the Claim ID, and the status reads **Failed**. Click the triangle: a popover with a close X: **Global Genius processing failed.** "Claim couldn't be processed in Global Genius: BKG-4102 Claim event rejected: business unit DE-CYB-01 is not mapped to a Global Genius ledger." "Retry to process it again." and a **Retry** link.

**Try:** Press Retry: the popover closes, a toast says it is retrying, the triangle goes and the status reads Open. After about 3 seconds the bell says the claim is now set up.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The colleague's design shows Failed on any claim with a Global Genius problem. Agreed change 1: Failed only when the claim itself couldn't be set up; a failed payment, reserve, recovery or section keeps Open. DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-2 in src/app/core/models/gg-dashboard.model.ts. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dashboard · Bank details wrong: Fix payment
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; colleague Figma design (claims portfolio triangle + popover, Claim Overview banner); UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** CLM-2024-025: red triangle after the Claim ID, status stays **Open**. Popover: **Global Genius processing failed.** "Payment to Rheinfeld Logistics AG not booked: the payee's bank details don't match what Global Genius has for them." and a **Fix payment** link. No Retry: the handler has to fix the data first.

**Try:** Press Fix payment: the Payments list of CLM-2024-025 opens with that payment open and the reason shown. Tick "I've corrected the bank details", Send again, confirm. After the toast, back on the dashboard the triangle is gone.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The colleague's design always offers Retry. Agreed change 2: when the handler has to fix data, the popover lists each broken item with a link straight to it, because a retry would fail again. DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-2 in src/app/core/models/gg-dashboard.model.ts. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dashboard · Finance-owned failures: nothing to do
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; colleague Figma design (claims portfolio triangle + popover, Claim Overview banner); UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The first build left Finance-owned failures off the dashboard. With the triangle on the claim they show, but say there is nothing to do and offer no action. A failure that was already sent again and failed again counts as Finance's (effectiveOwner in gg-booking.model.ts). DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-2 in src/app/core/models/gg-dashboard.model.ts. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; colleague Figma design (claims portfolio triangle + popover, Claim Overview banner); UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** CLM-2024-025, CLM-2024-028 (Failed), CLM-2024-029 and CLM-2024-026 are the first 4 rows, each with a triangle. Without problems, 026 and 029 sit below row 5 and don't show. Press it again: back to the normal top 5.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The colleague's design has no sort or filter. Agreed change 3: claims with a problem sort first, so none hide past row 5. View all claims does not carry the filter: the Claims list file is at its size limit. DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-2 in src/app/core/models/gg-dashboard.model.ts. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dashboard · Global Genius is down: no triangles
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; colleague Figma design (claims portfolio triangle + popover, Claim Overview banner); UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann, while Global Genius is unavailable.

**You see:** Yellow banner at the top: "Global Genius is unavailable. 2 items are waiting and will be sent automatically when it's back. Nothing to do." No triangle on CLM-2024-025 or CLM-2024-026 (their items wait for Global Genius). CLM-2024-029 still has a triangle: its payment has wrong bank details, which you have to fix.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Agreed change 4: while Global Genius is down, items it couldn't take get no triangle; the banner counts them. Red on every claim during downtime looks like many problems and is really zero actions. DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-2 in src/app/core/models/gg-dashboard.model.ts. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.
